name: When should I consider a roofing system selection consultation?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a roofing system selection consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a roofing system selection consultation if your roof is over 15-20 years old, shows signs of significant damage like widespread leaks or missing shingles, or if you're planning a home renovation that includes exterior upgrades. It's also beneficial if you're experiencing recurring issues or simply want to explore more durable or energy-efficient options available through Discounted Roofing Co.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a consultation if your roof is old, damaged, or if you're planning renovations. It's also for exploring durable or energy-efficient options.
